question.prompt: Points \(P(2m+1,3)\) and \(Q(-5,n-1)\) are symmetric about the origin. Find the value of \(m\cdot n\).

solutions.explanation: By symmetry about the origin, \(2m+1=5\), giving \(m=2\), and \(n-1=-3\), giving \(n=-2\). Therefore, \(m\cdot n=-4\).
solutions.title: Use opposite-coordinate equations
